_note: PAPER ONLY committee line. Modelled on Binance USDⓈ-M perps (XRPUSDT, BTCUSDT), isolated margin, long and short. No keys, no logins, no orders. All parameters fixed up front (textbook defaults), not tuned on any backtest.

common._mmr_note: Binance tier-1 maintenance margin: XRPUSDT 0.50%, BTCUSDT 0.40% (small positions).

_mix_note: mix = 2x by default; 5x only when all 4 voters agree, or the agreeing voters' average confidence >= 0.75 AND the 1h (EMA50 vs EMA200) and 4h (EMA20 vs EMA50) trends both point the same way.
_crowd_note: Crowded longs = at least 2 of: last funding >= +0.03%/8h, open interest (coins) up >= 5% in 24h, long/short account ratio >= its 80th percentile of the last 7 days. Crowded shorts mirror: funding <= -0.01%, OI up >= 5%, L/S ratio <= 20th percentile. Metrics are read with a 1-hour lag. Fear & Greed (alternative.me, daily, read with a 1h lag) adds one signal: > 75 extreme greed counts toward crowded longs, < 25 extreme fear toward crowded shorts. In extreme greed the long scout needs two triggers (one is not enough); in extreme fear the short scout does.
_theo_note: Theo's rules (unverified, each toggleable, fired rules logged per vote): R1 price/OI/funding read (price +1%/24h & OI +5% & funding >= 0.03% = don't chase longs; price -1% & OI +5% & funding < 0 = squeeze loading, don't chase shorts; price up & OI -2% = thin rally, long confidence -0.2; healthy trend = price and OI rising, funding not extreme). R2 veto: no LONG if funding > 27% annualised or long/short ratio > 1.8; no SHORT if funding < -27% or ratio < 0.55. R3: no longs while the last 4h close is below the 4h EMA200, no shorts while above. R4: flat and no entries from 15 min before to 15 min after CPI/PPI/FOMC (events_calendar.csv). R5: at 5x the stop is at most 2x ATR and 10% from entry; mix goes to 5x only in an R1 healthy trend. R6: OI +5%/24h with price within +-1% = leverage building in chop, idle guard votes IDLE.
